name: Arjuna (Pārtha, Dhanaṃjaya)
summary: In BhG 10–12 he acknowledges Kṛṣṇa as the supreme brahman (10.12), asks to hear his manifestations and to see his sovereign form (10.16–18, 11.3–4), receives the divine eye, describes and praises the universal form in fear and wonder (11.15–46), asks forgiveness for past familiarity (11.41–42), and asks which worshippers know yoga best (12.1); named by the Lord among his manifestations ('Dhanañjaya among the Pāṇḍavas', 10.37).
